caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat, overhanging lid. The chest is rendered in a light to medium brown color, resembling natural wood, and displays a wood grain texture throughout its surfaces. The front panel of the chest features two large, symmetrical arches, each enclosing a carved foliate or floral motif. There is a keyhole escutcheon centered between the two arch designs on the front. The side panel visible on the left also displays a similar arch with a matching foliate motif. The edges of the chest, particularly where the panels join, are detailed to show joinery. The chest is placed against a plain, off-white background with slightly darker, uneven, and aged edges.
title: Desk Box
